summary: Glass House Brands Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, containing two exhibits: a news release of preliminary Q1 2026 results and FY2026 guidance update, and a warrant redemption notice. The preliminary results show net revenues of $40M, gross profit margin of 25%, biomass production of 151,000 lbs., and period-ending cash of $27M. Full-year guidance includes revenues of $235-245M and adjusted EBITDA in the high $30M range. This is a routine earnings update with a standard earnings conference call announcement. A warrant redemption is also announced. No M&A, restructuring, or special-situation elements are present. No deal terms apply.
